evals.prompt: Add meaningful, page-prefixed HTML IDs to every element in the support-site/index.html file. The page prefix should be 'support_' and every HTML element (including html, head, meta, link, script, div, section, header, footer, nav, a, img, button, input, svg, path, ul, li, p, h1-h6, span, form, label) needs a unique id.
evals.expected_output: All elements in support-site/index.html have ids following the support_{context}_{purpose} pattern. IDs are readable and deduplicated.

evals.prompt: A small HTML file is missing all element IDs. Run the add-html-ids skill on this file with prefix 'landing_'. The file has a header with nav, a hero section, features section, and footer.
evals.expected_output: Every structural and inline element has an id following landing_{context}_{purpose} pattern.

evals.prompt: A complex HTML page with inline SVGs, forms, nested sections, and multiple nav lists is missing all element IDs. Run the add-html-ids skill on it with prefix 'shop_'. Verify svg child elements also get ids.
evals.expected_output: All elements including <path>, <circle>, <rect> inside SVGs have IDs. Nested lists and form inputs have unique, readable IDs.
